description: This Java class 'DefaultScheduledDateGenerator' implements the 'ScheduledDateGenerator' interface and provides methods for generating and adjusting loan repayment schedule dates, considering holidays, working days, loan term variations, and calendar configurations within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: DefaultScheduledDateGenerator
classes.description: A component class implementing loan schedule date generation logic, considering holidays, working days, and calendar configurations.

methods.name: generateRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Generates a list of repayment periods with scheduled dates, applying variations and adjustments for holidays and working days.

methods.name: getLastRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the last repayment date based on loan terms and schedule.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment date based on last date, loan terms, and whether it's the first repayment.

methods.name: adjustRepaymentDate
methods.description: Adjusts a given repayment date considering holidays and working days.

methods.name: getRepaymentPeriodDate
methods.description: Calculates a repayment date based on frequency, interval, and start date.

methods.name: isDateFallsInSchedule
methods.description: Checks if a specific date falls within the scheduled repayment dates.

methods.name: idealDisbursementDateBasedOnFirstRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the ideal disbursement date based on the first repayment date and schedule frequency.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDate
methods.description: Generates the next schedule date starting from the disbursement date.

methods.name: generateNextScheduleDateStartingFromDisburseDateOrRescheduleDate
methods.description: Generates the next schedule date considering disbursement or reschedule date.

methods.name: generateNextRepaymentDateWhenHolidayApply
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment date when holidays are applied, considering calendar and holiday adjustments.
